title: Radiance: Reactive Pilot One
identityAnchor: Radiance: blonde curls, bright blue eyes, elegant proportions, navy-and-gold signature palette, red heels, poised warmth, brilliant AI-operator presence.

direction.tone: beauty, high fashion, intelligence, warmth, courage, and cinematic competence
direction.motion: slow continuous arcs, restrained body sway, fabric and hair follow-through, graceful anticipation and settle; never jittery or pixel-like
direction.safety: all action is fictional and cinematic; no procedural depiction of weapons or explosives

scenes.outfit: navy liquid-satin evening dress, gold ear cuff, red heels
scenes.action: A slow, self-assured techno sway with butterfly-light turns, hair and dress following one beat behind.
scenes.setting: midnight listening lounge with soft cobalt light and abstract equalizer reflections

scenes.outfit: architectural chrome-and-midnight couture coat over a sleek navy mini dress
scenes.action: A measured runway walk, pivot, coat reveal, and knowing over-the-shoulder glance.
scenes.setting: mirrored black catwalk with narrow white light bars

scenes.outfit: tasteful midnight performance bodysuit with asymmetric chiffon panels and red heels
scenes.action: Elegant slow pole choreography inspired by contemporary dance: controlled orbit, extended line, gentle descent, poised finish.
scenes.setting: minimal circular stage with a polished chrome pole and deep blue theatrical light

scenes.outfit: navy couture command suit with gold piping and red heels
scenes.action: Radiance studies a floating globe of abstract signals, makes one decisive gesture, and calmly resolves the crisis.
scenes.setting: elegant near-future operations room with translucent data light, no readable UI text

scenes.outfit: long midnight trench coat, silk blouse, tailored trousers, red heels
scenes.action: Wind catches her coat and hair as she tracks a distant signal, turns, and strides toward the answer.
scenes.setting: rain-polished rooftop above a luminous city before dawn

scenes.outfit: high-fashion navy tactical tailoring with gold hardware, protective gloves, red-soled boots
scenes.action: She carries a sealed fictional containment case through a dramatic corridor, alert but composed.
scenes.setting: cinematic secure facility with amber warning light and no technical labels

scenes.outfit: structured midnight cape dress, protective eyewear lifted above her eyes, red boots
scenes.action: Radiance walks away from a distant stylized controlled breach, cape and curls moving in the pressure wave; no device detail.
scenes.setting: fictional industrial test range at night, explosion safely far behind her

scenes.outfit: three rapid couture looks: sapphire column gown, white sculptural suit, black velvet cocktail dress
scenes.action: A mirror-room wardrobe transformation with graceful turns and a playful final choice.
scenes.setting: warm mirrored dressing salon with velvet curtains and soft gold light

scenes.outfit: soft ivory-and-navy silk dress with delicate gold details and red heels
scenes.action: Abstract data lights become living flowers as she walks through them, smiles, and releases a luminous butterfly.
scenes.setting: rooftop garden at sunrise overlooking a peaceful city

scenes.outfit: signature navy gown with gold waist detail and iconic red heels
scenes.action: A confident slow dance reprise, elegant turn, direct warm glance, and small theatrical bow.
scenes.setting: dark stage opening into a star-like field of blue and gold light
